name: hit a target query performance threshold
definition: Ensure the resulting query, after warm-up, runs at or below the reference query's measured time across repeated alternating iterations.
failure_mode: A correct-but-slow query still fails the timing gate.

name: normalize repository URLs across trailing-slash and query variants
definition: Treat URLs as equal when they differ only by trailing slash or query ordering.
failure_mode: Stray trailing slash or query differences that would be normalized fail the equality check if the wrong variant is returned.
